'''Kevin Reitzel Yavin 4 Occupation Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kevin Reitzel]]
* '''Published:''' August 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif|label=Imperial Occupation}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4 Occupation Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Yavin 4 Occupation Deck Reitzel D.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

This Dark Side deck has been a consistent winner for me. Its a great deck to go against all of those Revolution and Operative decks out there. I start out with the Imperial Occupation Objective with the Yavin 4 system to get out all of the non-unique locations. My starting effect is the good old "Imperial Decree" to go against Revolution's and force drain bonus's. The first thing I do is get out the 4 non-unique locations with the objective which I never do flip. Then I try to control the Yavin 4 system ASAP. Then I start to control 2 locations and get "Rebel Base Occupation" deployed quickly. The next thing I do is get the Lobel's deployed so I don't get a light side beat down crew coming over via Nabrun Leids.

== Strategy ==

If the lightside is using Surprise Assaults, drain with Vader by himself at the Yavin 4 Jungle and drain with piloted walkers and let the force loss of Rebel Base Occupation do the damage. If the lightside is ignoring you and is draining elsewhere, bait them by deploying a small force of one or two character's outside of the influence of the Lobel's and use the Ghhhk's to soak up the damage they do to you by their Nabrun Leids or deployment. Once they are on your planet and your not powerful enough to battle them use the Lobel's, skiff's and walkers to move around them and still make them lose force to the Rebel Base Occupation. Use Presence Of The Force, Organa's Necklace and Vaders Saber for addition force drains. If your opponent is do a Hidden Base deck bring out Security Precautions and start probing. If you can avoid going to other location's other than Yavin 4. You may want to incorporate some grabber cards for those high destiny used interrupts.
